covers: JSE close and the first two hours of Wall Street, Wednesday 11 November 2026 (since the 17:20 evening update)
headline: JSE All Share closes 1.1% lower at 113,450 as Woolworths drops 8.5%; Nasdaq extends gains to 1.8% with CoreWeave up 24% and Brent climbs to $93.88
summary: The JSE All Share closed at 113,449.53, down 1.1% from Tuesday's 114,693.44, and the Top 40 at 105,558.44 (-1.1%), with Woolworths ending 8.5% lower and Naspers (-3.0%) and Prosus (-2.1%) the main drag, while the rand was at R16.60/$ (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 18:32 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 17:00-17:09 SAST). Wall Street built on its opening gains, with the Nasdaq up 1.8% at 25,528.80 and the S&P 500 up 1.2% at 7,611.99 two hours into the session as CoreWeave (+24.1%), Micron (+13.1%), AMD (+7.6%) and Nvidia (+4.1%) rallied, even as the US 10-year yield held at about 5.00% after hot inflation data (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 18:32 SAST). Brent rose to $93.88 after an OilPrice.com headline said Iran denied any talks with Washington, while gold slipped to $4,012.50, so oil risk and high US yields remain the key pressures on the rand (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 18:32 SAST; OilPrice.com headline, 11 Nov).

items.title: Nasdaq up 1.8% two hours into the session as AI shares rally
items.summary: At 18:32 SAST the Nasdaq Composite was at 25,528.80, up 1.8% from Tuesday's 25,065.88 close, and the S&P 500 at 7,611.99, up 1.2% from 7,520.93, both higher than shortly after the open. CoreWeave was at $60.46 (+24.1%), Micron at $820.46 (+13.1%), AMD at $554.14 (+7.6%) and Nvidia at $175.78 (+4.1%). A CNBC headline says CoreWeave's CEO Michael Intrator has cancelled his planned share-sale programme, and a MarketWatch headline says a single stock is responsible for a decline in the Dow; we could not open the articles to confirm details. Intraday levels; they will move before the 23:00 SAST close.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 18:32 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 18:32 SAST; CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: JSE All Share closes 1.1% lower; Woolworths down 8.5%
items.summary: The All Share closed at 113,449.53 and the Top 40 at 105,558.44, both 1.1% below Tuesday's closes of 114,693.44 and 106,738.05 and lower than late in the session. Woolworths Holdings ended at R37.78 (-8.5%) after a thenational.co.za headline said its sales had stalled; we could not open the article, so no sales figures are given. Naspers closed at R754.52 (-3.0%), Prosus at R684.00 (-2.1%), FirstRand at R96.42 (-1.4%) and Gold Fields at R622.33 (-2.6%), while Sasol (+2.4%) and Discovery (+1.7%) rose. Woolworths is not on our coverage list.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 18:32 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 17:00-17:09 SAST

items.title: Fed's Goolsbee calls the October inflation report 'borderline disturbing'
items.summary: A CNBC headline says Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee described Tuesday's consumer-price report as 'borderline disturbing' as the central bank weighs more rate hikes. October prices rose 0.4% on the month against 0.3% expected (LRC Macro Desk, BLS, 10 Nov 2026). We could not open the article for his full remarks. The Fed funds target is 3.75%-4.00% (LRC Market Dashboard).
items.source: CNBC headline, 11 Nov 2026 16:24 SAST; LRC Macro Desk (BLS), 10 Nov 2026

items.title: US 10-year yield holds near 5%
items.summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield was 4.998% at 16:43 SAST, little changed from Tuesday's 4.98% close. An Investing.com headline says global bonds fell as the hot US inflation data and Fed comments revived fears of a 0.5 percentage-point hike; we could not open the article to confirm market pricing.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 16:43 SAST; Investing.com headline, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: CoreWeave up 16% after raising its outlook
items.summary: CoreWeave was at $56.71 at 16:43 SAST, up 16.4% from Tuesday's $48.73 close, after the AI cloud company raised its outlook (CNBC headline). A separate CNBC headline says its CEO does not expect the 'new political reality' after the midterms to slow its data-centre build-out. We could not open the articles for the guidance figures.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 16:42 SAST; CNBC headlines, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: Goldman Sachs changes its Fed rate forecast after the hot inflation data
items.summary: MarketWatch reports that Goldman Sachs is changing its Federal Reserve interest-rate forecast after Tuesday's October consumer-price data, and Investing.com headlines say bets on a Fed rate hike have risen. We could not open the articles to confirm what Goldman now expects, so no figures are given.

items.title: Alibaba plans to list its T-Head chip unit
items.summary: Alibaba announced plans to list T-Head, which CNBC describes as a rival to Nvidia in chips.

items.title: Treasury upbeat on debt ratio and the path to investment grade
items.summary: A News24 headline says National Treasury is upbeat about government debt falling as a share of GDP, which it says clears a path back to an investment-grade credit rating. We could not open the article, so Treasury's figures and timeline are left out until they can be checked.

items.title: Unemployment rate rises to 33.7% in the third quarter
items.summary: Stats SA's QLFS showed the official unemployment rate up 0.1 percentage point to 33.7% in Q3 2026 from 33.6% in Q2. Employment rose by 101,000 to 16.8 million and formal-sector jobs by 268,000, but the number of unemployed also rose, by 97,000 to 8.6 million, as more people entered the labour force. The expanded (LU3) measure rose to 44.0%; youth unemployment eased to 47.3%. Released Tuesday 10 November (SAnews).

items.title: New fuel prices take effect today
items.summary: Adjusted petrol and diesel prices apply from Wednesday 11 November. IOL reports that part of the relief from lower oil prices is taken up by the new 'Slate levy'; we could not open the article to confirm the cents-per-litre changes, so they are left out.

items.title: Nersa admits electricity tariffs in three metros are unlawful
items.summary: Moneyweb reports the energy regulator has conceded that tariffs in three metros were unlawful. Details to follow once the article can be checked.

items.title: Dipula lifts its full-year dividend
items.summary: Moneyweb reports the property group raised its full-year dividend as earnings rose. Its shares were at R7.45, up 3.5%, at 14:10 SAST (LRC Stock Scanner quotes from Yahoo Finance). We could not open the article for the dividend figures.
items.source: Moneyweb headline, 11 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 14:10 SAST

items.title: Rand R16.60/$, R18.42/€, R22.05/£
items.summary: At 18:32 SAST the rand was at R16.60/$, a touch weaker than R16.59 at 16:43 and R16.51 on Wednesday morning, and at R18.42/€ and R22.05/£, as the US 10-year yield held near 5% (LRC Market Dashboard from Yahoo Finance data, 11 Nov 2026).

items.title: Gold $4,012.50; platinum $1,550
items.summary: Gold was at $4,012.50 and platinum at $1,550.00 at 18:32 SAST, both lower than at 16:43 ($4,033.30 and $1,557.60). JSE gold miners closed lower: AngloGold Ashanti R1,537.54 (-2.1%) and Gold Fields R622.33 (-2.6%) (LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 17:04-17:09 SAST).
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 18:32 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 17:04-17:09 SAST

items.title: Brent $93.88 as Iran denies talks; copper about $13,885/t
items.summary: Brent was at $93.88 at 18:32 SAST, up from $92.84 at 16:43 and about 1.5% above Tuesday's $92.47 close; copper was at about $13,885 a tonne. An OilPrice.com headline says Brent jumped nearly 3% as Iran denied any talks with Washington, and a CNBC headline says US Treasury Secretary Bessent was moved to a military base amid 'growing threats'. We could not open the articles to confirm their figures.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 18:32 SAST; OilPrice.com and CNBC headlines, 11 Nov 2026

items.title: Nvidia up 4.1% after the Baird downgrade
items.summary: Nvidia was at $175.78 at 18:32 SAST, up 4.1% from Tuesday's $168.89 close and higher than shortly after the open, after Baird downgraded the stock on worries about CEO Jensen Huang (CNBC headline, 11 Nov); we could not open the articles for Baird's new rating or target. Results are due on 17 November. Our BUY rating and fair value of $262.56 (LRC Watchlist) are unchanged; a broker downgrade does not change our rating, and the price remains well below that fair value.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 18:32 SAST; CNBC headline, 11 Nov 2026; LRC Watchlist

items.title: AMD up 7.6% with the chip rally
items.summary: AMD was at $554.14 at 18:32 SAST, up 7.6% on the day, as AI-linked chip shares rallied after CoreWeave's raised outlook (MarketWatch headline). The price is further above our fair value of $402.73; our SELL rating is unchanged (LRC Watchlist).
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 18:32 SAST; MarketWatch headline, 11 Nov 2026; LRC Watchlist
